title: zazzle invoker deployment diagram
description: What `make` produces and where it runs: one small executable per platform, run once per command in the user's shell, beside the zazzled it starts and the standalone tools it hands commands to. The same file is shipped as `zazz`, and `zazz install` links installed script commands to it; it tells them apart by the name it was started under. The daemon side is in macos/rust/zazzled/.dev/deployment-diagram.json; the release ships build/zazzle in the macOS and Linux tarballs beside zazzled, as zazzle and again as zazz.

sources.symbol: Build and smoke test the zazzle invoker

nodes.name: Mac
nodes.description: Apple silicon (arm64) only; Intel Macs have no zazzle.

nodes.name: Coding agent's shell
nodes.description: Runs `zazzle CMD ...` or `zazz CMD ...`, with ZAZZLE_SESSION set for ids and dedupe.

nodes.name: Developer's terminal
nodes.description: Runs a zazz script installed as a command: ~/.zazzle/bin/NAME, a symlink to the invoker.

nodes.name: zazzle process (Linux)
nodes.description: A static executable with no libc: raw syscalls only, its own `_start`.

nodes.name: zazzle process (macOS)
nodes.description: Loaded by dyld with libSystem, entered at `main`; its I/O, socket and exec calls are still raw syscalls.

nodes.name: zazzled serve process
nodes.description: The daemon; see the zazzled deployment diagram.

nodes.name: Program the invoker becomes
nodes.description: For `zazzle run`, `zazzle proxy`, `zazzle free-disk-space` and `zazzle fix-network`, the same process after exec: `zazzled wrap`, `zazzled proxy`, or the tool found beside the invoker, with the caller's environment, streams and exit status.

artifacts.name: build/zazzle (Linux)
artifacts.description: -Os -ffreestanding, linked -static -nostdlib -no-pie with sections garbage-collected, two LOAD segments (-z noseparate-code) and symbols stripped; shipped in the Linux release tarballs beside zazzled, as zazzle and as zazz.

artifacts.name: build/zazzle (macOS)
artifacts.description: -Os -ffreestanding with ZAZZLE_LIBSYSTEM, linked against libSystem with dead code stripped; shipped in the macOS release tarball beside zazzled, as zazzle and as zazz.
